context_objects.assessment: Exact positive weighted Pauli penalty terms with strict1–8 qubit/24term bound and matching lengths; commutation is pairwise algebra, not proof of independent stabilizer constraints or satisfiable target signs. Challenge parser supports legacy aliases and exact rational formats, rejects float/bool weights/counts/signs, defaults missing case/term data and IDs. Explicit IDs checked only against other explicit IDs, so an explicit ID can collide with an implicit index. Canonical integer text permits plus signs, surrounding whitespace and some Unicode digits; source bytes are normalized. Eigenvalue helper uses membership rather than exact type. No spectral diagonalization or native solver executed.
